pages.abstract: Eloy Alfaro International Airport is a joint use civil and military airport on the Pacific coast near Manta, a city in the Manabí Province of Ecuador. pages.abstract: Manta, also known as San Pablo de Manta, is a city in Ecuador, cantonal head of the Manta Canton, as well as the largest and most populated city in the Manabí Province.
